nodes.label: Runtime UI regression and DPI limitations
nodes.norm_label: runtime ui regression and dpi limitations
nodes.rationale: Uses isolated FourFixes database; checks navigation, bounds, handlers, columns, row numbering and disposal. Display matrix simulates available space, not physical DPI changes or Visual Studio Designer round trips.

nodes.label: Guna HTML label disposal compatibility
nodes.rationale: Reproduces four property null-reference failures and checks compatibility label with TypeDescriptor during and after disposal. Design-time context suppresses database and runtime event wiring.

nodes.label: Database-free editor action verification
nodes.rationale: 51 checks cover WinForms message-loop continuations, pending save navigation, failures, exception identity, action-state restoration and record-ID validation order. Does not replace SQL integration or Designer round trips.

nodes.label: Official project name update
nodes.rationale: Visible name and solution renamed while internal project names namespaces assemblies database and algorithms remain stable.

nodes.label: Final morning timetable import 18 October 2026
nodes.rationale: Pages 1-10 only; prior 67-faculty count superseded by cleanup; schedule source does not establish curriculum units or hours.

nodes.label: Fourth-year whole-section practical
nodes.rationale: Fourth year uses full section A in every branch and semester; migration is explicit with backup, transaction and validation.

nodes.label: Local PWA implementation
nodes.rationale: ASP.NET net8.0 host reuses existing BLL DAL Models and database without startup maintenance. API version check is not atomic against simultaneous desktop writes.

nodes.label: Incremental conflict repair
nodes.rationale: Historical change removed IsLocked from 277 lectures, retained valid identities, and repaired conflicting lectures only; later fresh-generation behavior is documented elsewhere.

nodes.label: Verified timetable restoration
nodes.rationale: Restored 277 original identities from corrected snapshot, room 301 capacity 60, with SQL backup and Serializable transaction. A later note supersedes permanent locks.

nodes.label: Preview and atomic approval
nodes.rationale: Search produces up to three time-distinct alternatives via ImportedTimetableRepairPlanner and CP-SAT; retains lecture identities and locks, validates stale versions, saves atomically after approval.

nodes.label: Independent branch capacity
nodes.rationale: Different branches remain independent bookings. Four lecture rooms plus two shared labs allow at most six simultaneous theory lectures; historical PDFs peak at seven.

nodes.label: Text-grid parsing and study scope
nodes.rationale: WeeklyPdfTimetableReader preserves merged cells, duration, branch/group labels and missing instructors. Morning/evening scope must be explicit; no OCR. Verified 17 pages, 235 lectures, 33 missing instructors.

nodes.label: Imported timetable repair
nodes.rationale: Moves allowed day period room only; preserves identity faculty section group semester duration and count. Requires complete validated repair plus user confirmation.

nodes.label: Excel and PDF import guide
nodes.rationale: PdfPig reads textual Arabic and English tables plus supported weekly grids. Preview does not write; confirmation uses validation and transaction; image OCR absent.

nodes.label: Provisional subject corrections 15 October 2026
nodes.rationale: Historical temporary subjects and faculty explicitly marked provisional; requires real names curriculum hours units and assignments later.

nodes.label: Scheduling capacity stress test 15 October 2026
nodes.rationale: 165 room bookings per semester is a numerical ceiling, not feasible schedule guarantee. Limited-search failure does not prove impossibility; results are historical resource configuration.
